wish: someone should make a simulator of plate tectonics
spec:
Simulates a wrap-around world of rigid plates drifting over time: collisions push up mountains, subduction builds arcs, rifts open new ocean floor, and land erodes.
Press Play or +10 Myr, change speed, switch between terrain and plate views, pick 4/7/12 plates, and drag on a plate to push it a new way.
It does not model mantle convection, real Earth geography, or climate; it is a toy grid model, not a geophysics solver.
